$comment: Fixture for glance.card. Keys are the SOURCE ALIASES (lead, more) because the offline realizer looks fixture values up by alias, not by sys.dataset id; no live id is declared so these lower to literals. Field names are the sys.dataset answer names in catalog.md. All records are SYNTHETIC demo data: no thumbnail is loaded, no search is run and no player url is opened in this offline build.
